component.name: CAMO
component.summary: Ultra Low Latency RTSP Virtual Camera Router

description.p: CAMO is a high-performance, Linux-native media routing layer inspired by professional IP video routers. It ingests RTSP IP camera streams with near-zero latency, decodes them using GPU hardware acceleration, and routes frames directly to video pipelines.

CAMO exposes virtual webcams natively as modern PipeWire video nodes and legacy V4L2 webcams, allowing any application (OBS Studio, Zoom, Discord, Chrome) to ingest the streams without buffering or latency.
